scope: Post-pilot algebraic diagnostic on the same saved input/target moments only; no new network training or inference. Fit the best shared quaternion-map perturbation around each stored folded prior for the SAME centered consumer-output ridge objective used by direct Q. Compare folded prior, numerically optimized shared-map subspace, and existing full-Q consumer solution. Numerical least-squares projection facts are background, not novelty. One existing CIFAR source/point; local regularized objectives, not a decomposition of whole-network accuracy or an architecture lower bound. No automatic wider study.
